description: Ask the user to give this connection a permission it lacks, returning an approval link for them to open. Use when a tool was refused with insufficient_scope and the user wants the task done; pass that refusal's `missing` permissions. Do not use it speculatively or for permissions the task does not need. It grants nothing and costs nothing by itself: only the user can approve, signed in to their dashboard, and they can remove the permission later. Asking again for the same permissions returns the same link.

permissions.description: The permissions to ask for, as scope names from get_permissions' not_granted list or a refused tool's `missing` field, e.g. ["instances:write"]

reason.description: One sentence, shown to the user on the approval page, on why you need it

name: request_permission
